Subject: Your breach of contract matter - Com. S. No. 1211/2019

Dear Ms. Mehra,

Thank you for meeting us on 24/01/2020 about your dispute with Meridian Logistics Ltd. As we understand it, the counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods. The matter is listed before the Kolkata Commercial Court.

Our advice is to invoke the arbitration clause and seek interim relief to secure the amount. Please collect the contract, the invoices and the delivery challans and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
